parameters.content:
## 1. Powder watch

Runs every 6 hours all season.

**Everything you change is in `⚙️ CONFIG`** - resort, thresholds, airports, saved taxi and bottle-shop contacts. Secrets are n8n credentials, never node parameters.

snow-forecast.com has no API, so this parses their marked-up table.

## This is what makes it real

`Save the trip` writes the trip to Supabase `japow_trips`.

A trip spans WEEKS - you cannot hold an n8n execution open that long. So the trip outlives this run, and **workflow 3** picks it up days later to track the flight and run the arrival sequence.

Without this table the rest of the system cannot exist.
